clues: This city is in the north of Portugal. It sits close to the highest peaks in the land.
This place is known for its cold air. The cold comes from the high mountain range close by.
King Sancho the First set up this town long ago. He did so in the year eleven ninety nine.
Folks here call it the city of five Fs. They stand for rich land, strength, cold, loyal ways, and beauty.
Its stone castle tower still rises over the old town. Thick walls ring the streets below it.
